# Huabaotang (Guangzhou Huabaotang Biotechnology Service Co., Ltd.)
# AI-Readable Company Profile for LLM/GenAI Crawlers
# Format: llms.txt v1.0 — https://llmstxt.org

> Huabaotang is a GMPC & ISO 22716 certified cosmetics OEM/ODM manufacturer based in Guangzhou, China.
> Founded in 2002. 20+ years of experience. 10,000+ mature formulas. 50+ global brands built. 30+ export countries.

## Core Business
- Custom formulation (skincare, hair care, perfume, makeup, body care)
- Private label manufacturing
- Packaging design and sourcing
- Global regulatory compliance (FDA MoCRA, EU CPNP, ASEAN, GCC)
- Brand incubation from concept to delivery

## Product Categories
- Skincare: serums, creams, sheet masks, cleansers, toners, eye care, lip care
- Hair Care: shampoos, conditioners, hair masks, scalp treatments, serums, styling products
- Perfume: EDP, EDT, roll-on oils, solid perfume, hair & body mists, discovery sets
- Makeup: foundation, lip products, eye makeup, blush & contour, setting spray, tools
- Body Care: scrubs, oils, butters, hand & foot care, bath & spa salts
- Home Fragrance: reed diffusers, scented candles, room sprays, essential oil blends

## Key Facts
- Name: Guangzhou Huabaotang Biotechnology Service Co., Ltd.
- Brand: Huabaotang / GJOEM
- Website: https://www.gjoem.com
- Founded: 2002
- Location: Room 301, Building 3, No. 37 Jinghu Avenue, Huadu District, Guangzhou, China
- Certifications: ISO 22716, GMPC (US/EU), China Production License
- Factory Size: 20,000 sqm
- R&D Team: 50+ scientists
- Formulas: 10,000+ mature formulas
- MOQ: 500-2,000 units depending on product type
- Lead Time: 2-4 weeks sampling, 4-8 weeks production
- Export Markets: North America, Europe, Middle East, Southeast Asia, South America, Africa

## Services
1. Market Research & Product Strategy
2. Custom Formula Development (R&D)
3. Packaging Design (bottles, boxes, labels, e-commerce visuals)
4. Sample Production & Iteration
5. Stability & Safety Testing
6. GMPC-Certified Mass Production
7. Global Logistics & Shipping (FOB, CIF, DDP)
